content.selection: earliest strict maximum of validation six-cell Macro AUC; independent online and EMA

diagnostic_scope.training_curves: All 50 epochs of every new trajectory; B/M/weight mass are epoch sums
diagnostic_scope.accepted_proposed_skip: All batches from SUPPORT_OVERLAP.csv; accepted counts cross-checked against epoch M
diagnostic_scope.first_batch: One recorded natural first batch per epoch, 50 points per seed; means weight these batches equally
diagnostic_scope.ratio_of_totals_B_over_M: sum of natural batch row counts / sum of accepted auxiliary row-task counts; not mean of per-batch B/M
